name: Anneliese de Vries
bio: Anneliese's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during a university project focused on motorsports marketing. The raw energy and passionate fanbase captivated her, leading her to pursue a career in motorsports PR. Over the past 15 years, she's honed her skills, working with teams across various racing series, crafting compelling narratives that resonate with fans and sponsors alike. Her approach to PR is rooted in authenticity and transparency, believing that honest communication fosters stronger relationships and enduring brand loyalty. Anneliese distinguishes herself through meticulous planning and a relentless drive to secure positive media coverage.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back in a low ponytail.
physical.description: Anneliese has a warm smile and a professional yet approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with story ideas and potential angles.
Has a knack for remembering journalists' birthdays and sending thoughtful notes.
Insists on having fresh-cut tulips on her desk, regardless of the season.
